newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Former Russian justice minister Kalmykov dies.
newsitem.headline: Former Russian justice minister Kalmykov dies.

text.p: Yuri Kalmykov, who as Russian justice minister was a key supporter of President Boris Yeltsin in his constitutional battle with parliament in 1993, died suddenly on Thursday, Interfax news agency said.

Kalmykov, 64, was appointed justice minister in April 1993 and stepped down, reportedly on health grounds, 18 months later. He supported Yeltsin through the showdown with parliament in October 1993 that ended with dozens of deaths.
Interfax gave no details of the cause of his death at an airport in the southern Russian town of Mineralnye Vody.
